kinds.label: Production filed

kinds.label: Completions
kinds.meaning: A well finished and reported. The strongest forward signal in the record, because production usually follows within weeks.

kinds.label: Permits
kinds.meaning: Intent to drill, not a well. A feed permit carries no lease number and no location, so it is matched by county; the ones from the well map carry coordinates and are measured in miles.

kinds.label: Neighbours
kinds.meaning: What sits inside your rings, from the standing radius survey. A standing fact rather than a dated event — press 1, 3 or 5 miles to change the ring.

kinds.label: Operator changes
kinds.meaning: A lease changed hands. Worth checking the first statement from the new operator against the last from the old.

kinds.label: Well status
kinds.meaning: A well moved between producing, shut-in or plugged. How a well going quiet becomes visible before the production record catches up.
